name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Fade H1's extremes: buy the AI-disruption-fear and macro-beaten-down names with real turnaround catalysts (ADBE/CRM/PYPL, oversold crypto, small caps, gold), while trimming the most overextended momentum trade (SOXL) short.

positions.thesis: Down ~49% H1 on AI-disruption fear that looks overdone; Firefly/AI-assistant monetization plus depressed valuation set up a mean-reversion catalyst.
Fell alongside ADBE on AI-replaces-SaaS narrative; Agentforce traction and management's margin-discipline reset offer a turnaround catalyst from depressed multiples.
Multi-year beaten-down fintech with new CEO-led restructuring, buyback support, and branded-checkout reboot underappreciated by the market.
3x semis ETF up +250% H1 is showing the first signs of correction after an extreme melt-up; sizing small given leveraged-ETF decay risk on the short side too.
Down 27% H1 in a deep crypto bear; oversold positioning and historically this magnitude of drawdown has preceded sharp mean-reversion rallies.
Down 36% H1, worst major-crypto laggard; smaller sizing reflects higher risk but asymmetric rebound potential if crypto bear finds a bottom.
Small caps still trailing despite a +19.4% H1 catch-up; further mean reversion likely as rate-cut expectations and broadening market favor cyclicals.
Gold down 6.5% H1 while equities ran hot; contrarian hedge that also benefits if risk-on unwinds or rate-cut cycle resumes.

outlook: Expect H2 to see partial unwind of the most extreme H1 moves (AI-momentum cooling, oversold AI-disruption-fear and crypto names stabilizing), rewarding contrarian turnaround positioning over chasing further momentum.
